title: SAP Architect
description:
**About Refold AI**

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

**About this role**

The SAP Architect is Refold’s resident SAP expert who owns the architecture for our hardest enterprise SAP problems. You’ve spent years working with SAP ecosystems, understand SAP architecture and enterprise processes inside out, and have a deep, hands-on command of SAP systems, data models, APIs, and how SAP connects with the broader enterprise technology landscape. You set the technical approach where there’s no playbook and serve as the primary technical point of contact for enterprise accounts on SAP architecture and implementations.

* **Team:** Senior technical IC role within the delivery org, owning SAP architecture and enterprise implementations.
* **Building**: Mission-critical agentic AI integrations involving complex SAP environments at enterprise scale — the problems for which no playbook exists yet.
* **You’ll work with:** CTOs, CIOs, VPs of Engineering, SAP leaders, and enterprise architecture teams at Fortune 500 enterprises and $50M+ ARR software companies.

**What you'll do:**

* Own the architecture for the hardest SAP problems. Design complex, mission-critical solutions involving SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP BTP, and other enterprise systems, addressing complex business processes, data flows, and cross-system dependencies, especially where no playbook exists yet.
* Be the technical POC for enterprise accounts. Serve as the senior SAP technical voice enterprise customers trust and the technical owner of their most important SAP architecture and implementation initiatives.
* Make the decisive technical calls. Own the hard decisions on SAP system architecture, data modelling, integration patterns, extensibility, agentic orchestration, authentication, error handling, and performance under real enterprise load.
* Speak credibly to enterprise security. Be the trusted technical voice with customers’ security and compliance teams on SAP security models, role-based access controls, SSO, VPC, mTLS, and our SOC 2 Type II / ISO 27001 / ISO 42001 / HIPAA posture.
* Shape product direction. Be the most credible field voice in the room. Translate patterns observed across SAP implementations, customer accounts, and deals into identified gaps, reference architectures, and durable product bets, partnering directly with Product and Engineering on the roadmap.
* Codify what works. Turn hard-won learnings into SAP reference architectures, implementation patterns, solution blueprints, and runbooks that scale across the delivery team and feed the support knowledge base.
* Bring architecture expertise to high-stakes deals. Partner with pre-sales on the prospects where getting the SAP technical approach right is what wins, leading architecture reviews, solution design discussions, and technical deep dives.

**What we're looking for:**

* 6–10 years of experience in SAP architecture, SAP technical consulting, or enterprise solutions architecture, with a substantial, demonstrable background in designing and delivering complex SAP solutions.
* Mandatory hands-on SAP experience with enterprise SAP environments, including SAP S/4HANA and/or SAP ECC, and a strong understanding of SAP architecture, implementation approaches, and enterprise business processes.
* Excellent, deep understanding of SAP integration capabilities and technologies, including SAP BTP Integration Suite, SAP APIs, OData, IDocs, RFCs, BAPIs, and relevant integration patterns.
* A deep technical problem-solver who designs solutions from first principles for problems that have no established answer.
* Deep expertise in SAP solution architecture, SAP data models, enterprise application landscapes, and modern cloud infrastructure.
* Strong technical communication; credible as the senior technical voice with CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, SAP leaders, and enterprise architects.
* Startup-grade agency, high ownership, low ego, comfortable building the playbook as you go.

**Nice to have:**

* Hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic frameworks (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, agent orchestration).
* Prior principal/staff SAP architect, lead SAP technical consultant, enterprise solutions architect, or founding solutions engineer role at a high-growth enterprise startup.
* Direct experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP BTP, SAP Fiori, SAP ABAP, and SAP business processes across finance, procurement, supply chain, or other enterprise functions.
* Experience with SAP integration and middleware technologies, including SAP CPI / SAP Integration Suite, alongside platforms such as Workato, Boomi, or MuleSoft.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, and Azure), containerised environments (Docker and Kubernetes), and modern data infrastructure.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
**About Refold**

Enterprise integrations are still built by hand, one customer at a time, by a human supply chain of consultants. We think that's the last big software category that hasn't been automated — and we're automating it.

Refold is the AI integration delivery layer. Our agents build, test, deploy, and maintain integration workflows inside our customers' own products, white-labeled, up to 90% faster. Trained on millions of real-world contexts across SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, and Salesforce, we turn integration work that used to take quarters into days — and then keep it running, because the agents detect failures and repair mappings themselves.

Traction: 30+ paying enterprise customers, 1,500+ active users, 10M+ API calls processed daily, seven-figure ARR. Customers include Incorta, Kantata, Coupa, Naehas, OvationCXM, and Zycus. The results are the pitch: Kantata ships integrations 75% faster with 8x delivery capacity; Incorta cut time-to-go-live by 70% and recovered 8,000+ engineering hours; Naehas went from 3–5-month builds to 90% faster delivery.

Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia and Abhishek Kumar, who have been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30. We've raised $6.5M led by Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber) and Tidal Ventures, with Better Capital, Ahead VC, Karman Ventures, Z21 Ventures, and Titan Ventures participating.

We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one. This is the second AE seat in the US and the first hired to build the motion, not inherit it.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Own the technical win:** Lead discovery, demos, and architecture conversations from first call to signature. When a deal is won or lost on technical confidence, that outcome is yours
* **Build the proof, don't slide it:** Stand up working prototypes against the customer's actual systems and messy data — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce. Our product is the demo; a deck is a fallback, not a strategy
* **Run crisp POCs:** Design focused evaluations with explicit success criteria, timelines, and exit conditions. We're deliberately moving away from 4-week POCs — help us prove value in days
* **Speak both languages:** Translate schema mapping, auth flows, multi-tenancy, and in-tenant deployment into terms a CTO trusts and a VP of Professional Services can build a business case on
* **Clear security and procurement:** Own architecture reviews, security questionnaires, and RFP/RFI responses. Air-gapped, in-tenant deployment is one of our strongest cards — know how to play it
* **Hand off clean:** Partner with Delivery and our Forward Deployed Engineers so every go-live starts from a real technical plan, not a rediscovery exercise
* **Feed the platform:** You'll be one of our highest-signal sources of product truth. Surface the gaps and friction you hit in the field and push them into the roadmap
* **Build the SE motion:** Turn what works into a demo library, discovery framework, POC playbook, reference architectures, and competitive teardowns against iPaaS incumbents

**Role Information:**

* **Partners with:** The founding AE team and the founders directly; backed by Forward Deployed Engineers and Delivery
* **Average deal size:** $50–100K land / $200–300K expand
* **Average deal cycle:** 3–6 months
* **Technical buyers you'll face:** CTOs, CPOs, VPs of Product, VPs of Professional Services / Delivery, plus platform architects and security reviewers
* **Ideal customer:** Sales-led with an integrations page, an internal PS team or SI dependency, and enterprise deals that hinge on connectors
* **Competitive set:** iPaaS and middleware incumbents (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, SnapLogic) and in-house build
* **Current growth team:** 1 BDR, 1 AE, 2 Marketing, 4 Post-Sale, plus a 20-person engineering and delivery org

**Required Skills & Abilities**

* **Proven SE:** 5–8 years in solutions engineering, pre-sales, or technical consulting at a SaaS, data, or AI company. This is a hard requirement — we're not training someone into the seat
* **Builder, not just a presenter:** Hands-on with APIs and data integration, and fluent enough in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript to build a working prototype yourself over a weekend
* **Enterprise systems fluency:** Real experience with systems of record — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Dynamics — and the messy parts: custom fields, schema mapping, OAuth, retries, idempotency, why an integration broke at 2 am
* **Sales instinct:** You've sold to or with product and professional services teams at software companies and understand what changes when your buyer's customer is the end user
* **Room-ready:** You can hold a CTO's attention, survive a security review, and be the calm one when the demo environment misbehaves
* **High ownership in ambiguity:** No playbook exists yet. You'll write it while running live deals, and you'll be comfortable doing both at once

**Nice to Have**

* Background in iPaaS, middleware, integration, or data infrastructure — or a track record of selling against MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or SnapLogic
* Hands-on with LLMs and agentic frameworks, not just familiar with the concepts
* Experience with air-gapped, in-tenant, or customer-VPC deployments and the security conversations that come with them
* Cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes)
* First-SE or early-stage experience where you built the function, not joined one
* Worked day-to-day with an offshore engineering or delivery team

title: Senior Digital Solutions Consultant
description:

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

**The Role**

***As a Senior Digital Solutions Consultant with Worley,*** you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

**Data Quality and governance**
-------------------------------

* Design, implement and continuously improve the enterprise Data Quality Framework, including standards, control patterns, rule lifecycle, scorecards, thresholds, exceptions and continuous improvement.
* Define and operationalise quality dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, validity and integrity.
* Partner with Data Owners and Data Stewards to identify Critical Data Elements, define rules and thresholds, assign accountability and agree remediation processes.
* Conduct profiling, anomaly detection, reconciliation, trend analysis and root-cause investigation across source, transformation and consumption layers.
* Develop dashboards and scorecards covering quality KPIs, failed controls, recurring defects, ageing issues and remediation progress.
* Maintain traceability between requirements, data assets, rules, findings, issues, lineage and remediation evidence.

**Collibra responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Configure and operate Collibra Data Quality datasets, jobs, profiling, rules, findings, schedules, scorecards, thresholds and alerts.
* Use Collibra Data Intelligence to connect business terms, technical assets, ownership, policies, quality rules, issues and end-to-end lineage.
* Integrate AWS metadata and quality outcomes with Collibra using Edge capabilities, connectors, REST APIs and supported integration patterns.
* Model and maintain communities, domains, assets, attributes, relations and responsibilities.
* Develop or enhance workflows for rule approval, issue triage, ownership assignment, remediation, exception approval and closure.
* Publish quality scores and issue status to governed assets so consumers can assess fitness for use.

**AWS and data engineering responsibilities**
---------------------------------------------

* Embed preventive and detective controls into ingestion, transformation and publishing pipelines using Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Amazon Redshift, AWS Lambda, Amazon Athena and Amazon CloudWatch.
* Develop reusable SQL and Python components for profiling, validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection and control automation.
* Implement logging, observability, alert routing, retry and failure-handling patterns.
* Apply IAM roles, least privilege, secrets management, encryption and approved network controls.
* Optimise rules and queries for performance, cost and maintainability across large datasets.
* Contribute to Git-based version control, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation and release management.

--------------------------

* Facilitate workshops with business and technical stakeholders and communicate trends, risks, recommendations and improvement plans.
* Partner with Architecture, Governance, Security and Data Platform teams to align delivery with enterprise standards.

* 8+ years of experience in Data Quality, Data Governance, Data Engineering, Analytics or Enterprise Data Management.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise Data Quality frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with Collibra Data Quality and Collibra Data Intelligence Platform.
* Strong knowledge of metadata management, business glossaries, lineage, stewardship and governance processes.
* Advanced SQL and strong Python skills for profiling, reconciliation, automation and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on knowledge of AWS data services, particularly S3, Glue, Redshift, Lambda, Athena, CloudWatch, Glue Data Catalog and IAM.
* Experience with ETL/ELT, data modelling, data warehousing and modern cloud data architectures.

* Ability to work independently and drive data quality issues through to verified closure.
